narr: A weak front acted as a trigger for multiple slow-moving thunderstorms with heavy rain that caused flash flooding in portions of east central GA.
ev: Columbia County Dispatch reported a creek overflowing Furys Ferry Rd at Southern Pines Dr.
Columbia County Emergency Management reported flash flooding at the intersection of Williams Few Parkway and Washington Rd in Evans.
Augusta Media reported a pond overflowing into property along Farmington Dr in Evans.
Broadcast Media reported flood waters entering homes in the Ivy Falls neighborhood of Grovetown, GA.
McDuffie County Dispatch reported water covering Lincolnton Hwy at Mary Boyd Rd.
Public reported street flooding along Scott Nixon Memorial Dr in Augusta.
Burke County Dispatch reported flash flooding on W Four Points Rd in four different spots.
Columbia County Dispatch reported flash flooding entering the Dollar General Market in Harlem.
